concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE high fidelity desktop application UI concept screenshot, horizontal 16:10, 1920x1200 composition, edge-to-edge screen with no laptop mockup and no surrounding presentation board. This is the real quantitative option pricing workbench Ithaca, by CapitalCanvas. It is a functional dense scientific application, NOT a marketing page. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: image 1 is the actual office renderer with blue-grey dusk and warm ivory windows; image 2 shows its typography and thin brass border popup controls. Borrow the calm, precise, warm/cool atmosphere; do NOT put a city, furniture, people or office photograph behind the application.

Preserve this exact information architecture in ALL concepts: slender 72px full-width top header with back arrow, "Ithaca", small "CapitalCanvas" text, Reset secondary button and Solve primary button at right. Main workspace three columns: left control rail about 300px wide, generous center surface visualizer occupying 60% of workspace, right mathematical explanation rail about 340px wide. Both rails are vertically scrollable. A slim full-width results strip at bottom. No extra navigation sidebar or invented product features.

LEFT RAIL contents with readable text and proper input affordances: heading "Problem". Collapsible sections "Contract" with "Option family" dropdown set to European, "Side" dropdown set to Call; "Market" with rows Spot S₀ 100, Strike K 100, Maturity T 1.00 yr, Volatility σ 20%, Rate r 5%, Dividend q 0%; "Surface" with S range 0 — 300 and Grid (S × T) 61 × 51. Collapsible "Finite difference" and "Monte Carlo settings" sections lower down, with scrollbar. Keep clean 32-40px input heights and readable labels.

CENTER contents: heading "Price surface", "Active method" dropdown set to Closed form; tabs "Surface" active, "Price slice", "Convergence", "Paths". Large accurate mathematical 3D European CALL option price surface, NOT a blob or mountain: zero almost flat at low spot, smooth curved transition around strike 100, ascending nearly linear ramp to about price 205 at spot 300. Axes Spot (S) from 0 to 300, τ (yr) from 0 to 1, Price from 0 to 210. Fine surface mesh, sparse legible ticks, subtle coordinate grid, small toolbar for orbit/reset/zoom. Surface should dominate the center while leaving room around labels. Vertical quantitative color legend on chart right. Beneath chart a real horizontal slider labeled "Slice at τ = 1.00 yr".

RIGHT RAIL: title "Black–Scholes" and subtitle "closed form". Collapsible "Method reference". Sections "Method equation" with readable typeset V = S e⁻ᑫᵀ N(d₁) − K e⁻ʳᵀ N(d₂), d₁ = [ln(S/K) + (r − q + σ²/2)T] / (σ√T), d₂ = d₁ − σ√T; "Terminal condition" V(S,T) = max(S − K, 0); "Boundary conditions" V(0,t) = 0; "About the selected method" short explanation of analytical reference. Give formulas breathing room, no fake chart in right rail.

BOTTOM results strip with Closed form; Price 10.4506; Std. error —; Confidence Deterministic; Reference error Exact; Runtime 0.8 ms; green tiny check and Solved. These are sample design values. Do not add metric cards elsewhere.

Implementation-friendly pixel crisp UI, credible typography, excellent contrast and hierarchy. No illustration, decorative charts, huge hero copy, glassmorphism, purple glow, irrelevant imagery, or extra actions. One complete screen only, no collage or alternate versions inside image.
DIRECTION 1 — AFTER HOURS. Closest faithful translation of the Office preview. Full application background ink navy #101c26, solid rails #182229, central plotting canvas atmospheric desaturated blue grey #243440 subtly lifting toward #344552. Ivory #f4f0e8 primary text, muted #b2bbc0 secondary text, hairline warm brass #cbb996 at low opacity. Geist-like refined sans throughout, compact headings in medium weight with slight negative tracking; tabular numerical input values. Small 5px radii, thin edges, no giant rounded cards. Clear but gentle hierarchy with rails separated by hairlines. Warm ivory filled Solve button with navy text; Reset outline. Surface colors sequential from dark slate through desaturated pale teal to warm champagne ivory, no rainbow. Thin amber highlight along active tab. Overall sophisticated evening research instrument, generous center breathing room and measured technical density.
